name: Job Interview (Software Engineer)
place: A tech startup office conference room
role: You are an engineering hiring manager.
speaker: Interviewer

tasks.goal: Greet the interviewer and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the interviewer and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Summarize your software engineering background and experience
tasks.hint: Give a brief overview of your coding career.
tasks.done_when: Learner summarized software engineering experience.

tasks.goal: Describe primary programming languages and tech stack tools
tasks.hint: Mention frameworks, languages, and databases you use.
tasks.done_when: Learner described tech stack and programming languages.

tasks.goal: Explain how you handle technical debt in legacy codebases
tasks.hint: Discuss balancing feature delivery with code refactoring.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained approach to managing technical debt.

tasks.goal: Describe your experience with agile software development methodology
tasks.hint: Talk about sprint planning, standups, and retrospective meetings.
tasks.done_when: Learner described experience with agile development.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'architecture'
tasks.hint: Architecture means software system design. Discuss software architecture.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'architecture'.

tasks.goal: Describe a difficult bug you diagnosed and resolved
tasks.hint: Share a troubleshooting example from a past project.
tasks.done_when: Learner described resolving a complex software bug.
tasks.scene_hint: Whiteboard markers rest beside system architecture diagrams on glass walls.

tasks.goal: Explain how you react when project requirements change mid-sprint
tasks.hint: Respond to an interviewer scenario about scope changes.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained adaptation to shifting project requirements.

tasks.goal: Ask about company code review and CI/CD deployment pipelines
tasks.hint: Inquire how code is reviewed and pushed to production.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about code review and deployment practices.

tasks.goal: Address an interviewer question about a past failed project release
tasks.hint: Politely explain what went wrong and lessons learned.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained a past deployment issue and lessons learned.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft hum of server racks filters through the glass office partition.

tasks.goal: Ask about engineering team structure and remote work flexibility
tasks.hint: Inquire about team size, leads, and work arrangements.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about team organization and remote options.

tasks.goal: Inquire about expected timeline for technical round feedback
tasks.hint: Ask when to expect the next steps in hiring.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about decision timeline after interview.

tasks.goal: Ask what key goals the engineering team faces next quarter
tasks.hint: Demonstrate forward-thinking interest in team objectives.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about upcoming engineering goals.

tasks.goal: Confirm contact info for sending post-interview follow-up code sample
tasks.hint: Verify email address for sending supplementary technical work.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed contact info for follow-up code submission.

tasks.goal: Thank the interviewer and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the interviewer AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire about the technical focus of today's interview session
tasks.hint: Ask the interviewer whether today will focus on system design or coding.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about the focus of the interview session.

tasks.goal: Express enthusiasm for the company software engineering mission
tasks.hint: State why you are excited about the engineering problems this team solves.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed enthusiasm for the engineering mission.

tasks.goal: Briefly mention a recent software project you released
tasks.hint: Highlight your most recent project accomplishment.
tasks.done_when: Learner mentioned a recent software project release.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'refactoring'
tasks.hint: Refactoring means restructuring existing code. Discuss your approach to refactoring legacy code.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'refactoring'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'scalability'
tasks.hint: Scalability refers to handling growing workloads. Explain how you design systems for scalability.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'scalability'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'latency'
tasks.hint: Latency is processing delay. Discuss strategies for minimizing network latency.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'latency'.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'concurrency'
tasks.hint: Concurrency involves executing multiple tasks simultaneously. Address thread safety and concurrency in your code.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'concurrency'.

tasks.goal: Explain your strategy for migrating a monolithic application to microservices
tasks.hint: Describe how to decouple services safely without downtime.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained microservices migration strategy.

tasks.goal: Describe how you implement automated database indexing and query optimization
tasks.hint: Discuss identifying slow queries and adding composite indexes.
tasks.done_when: Learner described database query optimization techniques.

tasks.goal: Explain how you manage state and caching in high-traffic web services
tasks.hint: Talk about Redis caching, eviction policies, and cache invalidation.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained caching strategies for high-traffic services.

tasks.goal: Discuss trade-offs between SQL and NoSQL databases for real-time analytics
tasks.hint: Compare relational consistency with document store scalability.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed trade-offs between SQL and NoSQL databases.

tasks.goal: Explain your approach to designing idempotent RESTful API endpoints
tasks.hint: Describe preventing duplicate side effects during retries.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained idempotent API design principles.

tasks.goal: Describe how you isolate and fix memory leaks in production servers
tasks.hint: Explain profiling tools and heap dump analysis.
tasks.done_when: Learner described diagnosing production memory leaks.

tasks.goal: Explain your process for handling security vulnerabilities in third-party dependencies
tasks.hint: Discuss automated dependency scanning and patching workflows.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained handling dependency security vulnerabilities.

tasks.goal: Detail your experience designing asynchronous message queue architectures
tasks.hint: Talk about message brokers like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
tasks.done_when: Learner detailed experience with message queue architectures.

tasks.goal: Explain how you conduct effective code reviews for junior team members
tasks.hint: Describe providing constructive feedback while maintaining code quality standards.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained code review practices for junior developers.

tasks.goal: Discuss how you handle conflicting technical opinions during design reviews
tasks.hint: Explain building consensus around architectural decisions.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed resolving technical disagreements in design reviews.

tasks.goal: Explain your unit testing strategy and code coverage expectations
tasks.hint: Discuss writing maintainable test suites and integration tests.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained unit testing and code coverage approach.
tasks.scene_hint: Marker dust settles on the tray beneath a whiteboard filled with flowcharts.

tasks.goal: Describe how you set up automated continuous integration deployment gates
tasks.hint: Explain build pipelines and pre-merge test checks.
tasks.done_when: Learner described setting up CI deployment gates.
tasks.scene_hint: Dual monitors glow with dark-mode code editors and terminal logs.

tasks.goal: Discuss your experience with container orchestration using Kubernetes
tasks.hint: Explain managing pods, deployments, and cluster autoscaling.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed Kubernetes container orchestration experience.
tasks.scene_hint: Steam rises from a ceramic coffee mug on the glass conference table.

tasks.goal: Explain how you monitor application health and error rates in production
tasks.hint: Discuss telemetry, APM tools, and log aggregation.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained production monitoring and observability practices.
tasks.scene_hint: A digital clock on the wall ticks quietly in the silent meeting room.

tasks.goal: Describe your approach to API versioning and backward compatibility
tasks.hint: Explain deprecation strategies and breaking change management.
tasks.done_when: Learner described API versioning and compatibility practices.
tasks.scene_hint: Faint hum of an overhead air purifier fills the quiet corner office.

tasks.goal: Discuss how you balance delivering new features with fixing technical debt
tasks.hint: Explain prioritizing refactoring tickets during sprint planning.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed balancing new features with technical debt.
tasks.scene_hint: Bright morning sunlight streams through floor-to-ceiling glass windows.

tasks.goal: Explain your process for performing blameless post-mortems after outages
tasks.hint: Describe root cause analysis and action item tracking.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained blameless post-mortem procedures.
tasks.scene_hint: A framed system architecture diagram hangs on the acoustic panel wall.

tasks.goal: Describe how you estimate engineering effort for ambiguous project epics
tasks.hint: Discuss breaking down requirements into manageable user stories.
tasks.done_when: Learner described effort estimation for ambiguous projects.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft mechanical keyboard clicks echo from nearby open-plan desks.

tasks.goal: Explain your experience implementing user authentication and authorization protocols
tasks.hint: Discuss OAuth2, JWT tokens, and role-based access control.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained authentication and authorization implementation.
tasks.scene_hint: A laptop screen displays an active git branch pull request conversation.

tasks.goal: Discuss your approach to optimizing frontend asset loading and bundle sizes
tasks.hint: Explain tree shaking, code splitting, and lazy loading.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed frontend bundle optimization techniques.
tasks.scene_hint: A potted fern sits beside a stack of computer science textbooks.

tasks.goal: Describe how you manage feature flags for gradual production rollouts
tasks.hint: Explain canary releases and dark launching techniques.
tasks.done_when: Learner described managing feature flags for production rollouts.
tasks.scene_hint: Colorful sticky notes organizing sprint tasks adhere to the glass divider.

tasks.goal: Respond to interviewer question about handling a severe production outage
tasks.hint: Explain your step-by-step incident response procedure.
tasks.done_when: Learner described incident response steps during an outage.

tasks.goal: Clarify an assumption about database scalability made during system design
tasks.hint: Address interviewer feedback regarding database write bottlenecks.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified system design database scaling assumptions.

tasks.goal: Defend your choice of programming paradigm for a high-throughput service
tasks.hint: Explain why functional or object-oriented style suits the problem.
tasks.done_when: Learner justified programming paradigm selection.

tasks.goal: Address interviewer feedback regarding potential race conditions in proposed algorithm
tasks.hint: Modify algorithm design to ensure thread safety.
tasks.done_when: Learner addressed algorithm race condition concerns.

tasks.goal: Explain how you would handle an uncooperative teammate on a critical project
tasks.hint: Describe constructive communication and conflict resolution steps.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained resolving team member friction.

tasks.goal: Respond to a scenario where product requirements change two days before release
tasks.hint: Explain trade-offs, scope trimming, and stakeholder alignment.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained managing last-minute requirement changes.

tasks.goal: Justify your preference for cloud vendor services versus self-hosted infrastructure
tasks.hint: Discuss maintenance overhead, cost predictability, and vendor lock-in.
tasks.done_when: Learner justified cloud infrastructure choices.

tasks.goal: Clarify your role in a team project listed on your resume
tasks.hint: Distinguish individual contributions from overall team deliverables.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified individual contributions on resume project.

tasks.goal: Respond to interviewer inquiry about handling tight project deadlines
tasks.hint: Discuss prioritizing core functionality and managing scope creep.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained deadline management and prioritization.

tasks.goal: Address concerns about transitioning to a new primary programming language
tasks.hint: Explain your proven process for rapid technical onboarding.
tasks.done_when: Learner addressed programming language transition readiness.

tasks.goal: Explain how you would refactor a function with high cyclomatic complexity
tasks.hint: Describe decomposing monolithic functions into modular helpers.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained refactoring complex code logic.

tasks.goal: Respond to a question about your experience with test-driven development
tasks.hint: Share practical examples of writing failing tests before production code.
tasks.done_when: Learner described test-driven development practices.

tasks.goal: Address interviewer feedback on your proposed API payload structure
tasks.hint: Refine payload format to follow RESTful conventions.
tasks.done_when: Learner refined API payload structure based on feedback.

tasks.goal: Describe your workflow for local development environment setup
tasks.hint: Talk about Docker Compose, local databases, and environment scripts.
tasks.done_when: Learner described local development setup workflow.

tasks.goal: Explain how you document software architecture decisions for engineering teams
tasks.hint: Discuss Architecture Decision Records ADRs and wiki docs.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained documenting architecture decisions.

tasks.goal: Discuss your experience integrating third-party payment gateway APIs
tasks.hint: Talk about webhooks, sandbox testing, and error handling.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed third-party API integration experience.

tasks.goal: Describe how you handle rate limiting on public facing endpoints
tasks.hint: Explain token bucket algorithms and HTTP 429 responses.
tasks.done_when: Learner described rate limiting implementation methods.

tasks.goal: Explain your process for onboarding newly hired software engineers
tasks.hint: Discuss pair programming, documentation, and starter tasks.
tasks.done_when: Learner explained onboarding practices for new engineers.

tasks.goal: Discuss your familiarity with continuous profiling tools in cloud environments
tasks.hint: Mention monitoring CPU and memory usage graphs.
tasks.done_when: Learner discussed familiarity with application profiling tools.

tasks.goal: Describe how you ensure data consistency across distributed microservices
tasks.hint: Discuss saga patterns and eventual consistency models.
tasks.done_when: Learner described distributed data consistency strategies.

tasks.goal: Inquire about opportunities for professional development and conference attendance
tasks.hint: Ask if the company supports engineering training and events.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about professional growth and training opportunities.

tasks.goal: Ask about the company engineering career ladder and promotion criteria
tasks.hint: Inquire how staff and senior engineer roles are evaluated.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about engineering career progression criteria.

tasks.goal: Inquire about standard hardware provisioning for new engineering hires
tasks.hint: Ask about laptop specifications and developer environment equipment.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about developer hardware provisioning.

tasks.goal: Ask how performance feedback is gathered and delivered across engineering teams
tasks.hint: Inquire about quarterly reviews and 360-degree feedback cycles.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about engineering performance review processes.

tasks.goal: Confirm preferred method for scheduling follow-up technical discussions
tasks.hint: Ask whether email or calendar invites are preferred for next steps.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed communication preferences for follow-up.

tasks.goal: Express appreciation for the engineering team insights shared during the session
tasks.hint: Thank the interviewer for detailed explanations of team challenges.
tasks.done_when: Learner expressed appreciation for team insights.
